column2: Y-yes... somehow.
Well, well, you sure hang in there...
*huff* *huff* *huff*...
In time, its authority grew to the point that even the nobility and knight class could not ignore it, and later led to the formation of a new order centered on the Church.

[Relic of an Ancient Civilization (Artifact)] ||| Era: Unknown ||| "Artifacts" are strange relics in the form of vessels, staffs and other shapes that are very rarely unearthed from ruins. ||| In the doctrine of the Septian Church, they are linked to the Seven Sept-Terion given by the Goddess, and recovering them is one of the Church's duties.
The Artifact on display was also recovered by the Church. ||| They are often said to possess supernatural power, but this exhibit has long since lost its function and does not work.

[Ritual Implements of the Septian Church] ||| Era: Around Septian Year 900 ||| The Septian Church has produced many works of religious art, and its origins can be traced to the Church of the stable period. It is thought that the statue of the Goddess of Sky took its present form around this time. Many of the ritual implements in use today were also standardized in this era.

[Manuscript of the Septian Scriptures] ||| Era: Around Septian Year 500 ||| A copy of the scriptures used by the early Septian Church at the end of the Dark Ages. Since printing did not exist in the Middle Ages, this book was copied by hand onto paper made from tanned animal hide.

[Medieval Spinning Wheel] ||| Era: Around Septian Year 900 ||| A manual machine for spinning thread. In the stable Middle Ages, peasant life grew richer and crops like cotton were grown as commodities. It was also the era when handicrafts arose as a way to earn money.
Yes!
...Still, I have much training left to do myself. ||| I would like to undergo proper training once. ||| Once things settle down a bit, I'll consult Hernan.
Ah, Joshua. ||| Thank you for your hard work these two weeks. ||| Your reports on the damage in each region helped us assign personnel. ||| It was a great help.
Oh, no... ||| ...Um, Kurt. It's about my bracer qualification...
...You probably know already, but my powers were originally given to me by the Ouroboros. ||| And I used that power to commit many sins. ||| So someone like me calling himself a bracer...
Joshua, I believe... ||| that power is always imperfect. ||| That is why mere humans are able to wield it. ||| ...Am I mistaken?
...Then what difference is there between you and me? ||| We know ourselves to be unrefined, yet keep wielding our power for our convictions...
...I suppose so... ||| I'm not very confident, though...
Heh, keep striving. ||| And this is only my opinion, but... ||| I think you are a more than capable bracer.
...Anyway, you two over there seem to have energy to spare. ||| Are they always like this?
Heh, I've been dragged around to all sorts of regions to help out lately... ||| Finally I can catch my breath. *munch munch*...
Honestly, you two are such kids. ||| You're a little too giddy just because it's peaceful, aren't you?
Yeah, I think it'll suit them! ||| I'll have them try it on later!
Hmm, let's see. ||| Josette with red earrings and a small ribbon, and Estelle with her hair down... ||| Then I think both of them would look great in white dresses.
Hey, Joshua, what do you think?
Don't ask me all of a sudden...
Oh, so Josette was a noble. ||| I thought Imperial nobles were scarier people... ||| Heehee, maybe a lot of them are surprisingly cute?
The Orbal Stoppage and the Empire's steam tank corps... ||| The Republic's parliament is said to be in an uproar too. ||| It will probably take a long while for that to calm down.

A celebration, huh... ||| It really makes you feel peace has returned. ||| Still, the response during the Incident and the precise reconstruction orders across the land... ||| Queen Alicia's skill surprised me all over again. ||| The Republic could never have managed this.
Ah, we've been waiting for you.
Huh...?
Oh... ||| So this is the one we were just discussing?
Indeed, this is Joshua. ||| I was just telling the Ambassador about your exploits.
An honor to meet you. ||| I am Davil Kleinach, Ambassador to Liberl.
U-um...

The part where you boarded the floating city brought tears to my eyes. ||| Knowing it was a one-way ticket, you shook off your beloved's hand and joined the suicide mission... ||| Truly, young people like you are the treasure of a nation.
Th-thank you very much. ||| (...What on earth did they tell him...?)
And here, the two who made their miraculous reunion...
What a splendid spirit these youths have... It brought tears to my eyes. ||| Truly, young people like you are the treasure of a nation.
Thanks to Brigadier General Cassius, I am to receive a pardon, but... ||| ...I should settle things in my own way too.
Mr. Richard... You came?
Yes... thanks to the Brigadier General. ||| I'm to receive an official pardon from Her Majesty.
For your achievement in stopping the Ouroboros' attack on the capital. ||| Congratulations.
...No, honestly, it's more than I deserve... ||| ...Now that peace has come, perhaps I should face the sins I committed squarely.
Mr. Richard...
Heh, don't make such a worried face. ||| I have no intention of doing anything that betrays Her Majesty's kindness. ||| It's just that I should settle things in my own way. ||| ...That's all I mean.
Y-you're done here, aren't you? Go away at once. ||| You're in His Excellency's way.
...You... ||| Your reinforcements when the capital was attacked really helped. ||| Allow me to thank you.
H-hmph... That was a condition of His Excellency's release. ||| I don't owe you any gratitude.
(She's not very honest...)
...Zin, were you invited to the celebration too?
Pyupyui!
(Well, with what Zin did, he deserves an award...)
I put my skills to work tonight.
Please, don't hold back and enjoy.
Is there enough food?
Just say so and I'll bring more.
H-hey, young ladies...
Please don't fight.
I'm a temporary chef who came from Saint-Heim Gate to help.
Being put in charge of a venue like this is an honor for a chef.
Phew, what a grand party.
Still, being put in charge of a venue like this is an honor for a chef.
Master Joshua, please come play anytime.
I'll help you change clothes...
...Please come again anytime.
...No, I won't be wearing a maid outfit anymore.
Looking at it now, that day feels like it never happened.
It really feels like the incident is over.
Phew, looking at it now, that day feels like it never happened.
When the castle gate collapsed and those scary people came in...
I thought I'd faint.
Honestly, the Ouroboros or whatever they are...
I never want to go through that again.
It feels like peace has finally returned to this castle.
Until recently, we were so busy cleaning up everywhere.
Um, next I'll pour for that guest over there...
Um, and then, and then...
Oh, sir...
Did I already hand you your food?
Phew, so many guests today.
Here, please have this dish.
Please eat it while it's hot.
Oh, sir. Do you have a drink?
We also have non-alcoholic cocktails.
Thank you for attending the celebration.
Please take your time and enjoy yourselves.
The celebration is held throughout the Hanging Gardens.
Please enjoy your conversations.
Please enjoy the celebration.
...I'm sorry. Beyond this point is the Queen's Palace.
So this is the last I'll see of Liberl's moon... ||| I feel a little reluctant.
Heh, it seems you've finally begun to understand what elegance is. ||| Well, let's do our best so we can come see it again. ||| While we're still alive, that is.
Heh, indeed.
The next morning--
There's a "Liberl Newsletter" on the bookshelf.
You have read every fragment of knowledge I granted... ||| In praise of your spirit of inquiry, I bestow my blessing upon you...

* Information on enemies you fight is automatically recorded in the Monster Handbook. ||| * What gets recorded changes depending on whether you win the battle or flee. ||| * To open the Monster Handbook: use it from the [Books] category of the Camp screen's [Items] tab, or press the Triangle button + Right on the D-pad.
Use a Sept-Stone to teleport.
Press the Triangle button + Down on the D-pad to open the Sept-Stone menu and choose where you want to teleport.
U-um, shall we check that door over there first? ||| If that door is the "Rule," I think it might be a clue.
Yeah, you're right.
Yes, you're right.
Um... this is the way forward, right? ||| First we have to check that door.
Thou, maiden of great talent in orbal technology, bring her to me. ||| Then I shall open the Door...
Where... am I...
...I see... a dream...
Estelle... ||| And Joshua... ||| ...Even Tita is here... ||| Hehe... What a convenient dream.
Oh...
Hehe... Estelle, honestly... You're the big sister, yet so clingy.
And... ...she's so warm and smells nice... ||| It feels just like it isn't a dream--
...It seems we can finally see the way ahead. ||| For the sake of those who fell, we must press on. ||| The Seventh Stratum... Let's see this world's origin with our own eyes.
...It seems we can finally see the way ahead. ||| Olivier, watch your step.
Heh, of course, big brother.
...Who's your big brother?
...It seems we can finally see the way ahead. ||| Time to drag Olivier along, I suppose...
So that is one who mastered the Way... ||| Heh... I still have a long way to go.
The renowned technique of the Sword Sage... ||| Hmm... I wish I could have seen it with my own eyes.
That Shadow Lord... He seems to have gathered quite skilled fighters. ||| Still, with two Guardians like that... ||| *sigh*, this doesn't bode well...
The Shadow Lord seems to have gathered quite skilled fighters. ||| Come to think of it, the Black Knight also called himself a guardian...
...Olivier, don't cause any trouble. ||| Even in another dimension, your antics could become an international incident.
Ha ha ha, you worry too much.
...Listen seriously.
...You incorrigible fool. ||| I'll teach you a lesson.
...Don't mind this fellow. ||| I'll take responsibility and discipline him.

So the Sept-Stone had such a history... ||| That explains why we were pulled into the Phantasma. ||| But it seems the Shadow Lord carried it out. ||| Hmph, I'd like to drag him out as soon as possible...
The Sept-Stone of Reclus... ||| That explains why we were pulled in. ||| ...But it seems the Shadow Lord carried it out. ||| I'd like to drag him out soon...
...The situation may be more serious than I imagined. ||| If this world and its Rules were created by the Shadow Lord... ||| We cannot rule out that this is a space we can't escape.
...The only salvation is the spirit of the woman. ||| The Shadow Lord's power doesn't seem to reach this garden...

Former Royal Army Intelligence Colonel Alan Richard... ||| He inherited the sword from the Sword Sage, and I hear he's formidable in battles of wits and intelligence too. ||| Heh... A man I wouldn't want as an enemy.
Former Royal Army Intelligence Colonel Alan Richard... ||| As an ally, there could be no better strength.
The Gralsritter... ||| Olivier once studied them eagerly, but apparently couldn't learn much. ||| But having seen that power, I think I understand why he did.
The ability to hunt that "demon" in an instant... ||| One could truly call it a supernatural gift...
...Come to think of it, I don't see Olivier anywhere. ||| Honestly, turn my back for a moment and this happens... ||| Can't he behave even when pulled into another dimension?
A bracer at the Bracer Guild facility, I see. ||| Well, they do seem to follow stylistic convention.
Hmph... I'll leave him be for a while. ||| He wouldn't leave this garden without a Sept-Stone anyway.
Those masked people... I dislike them, but they do keep the rules. ||| ...I wish there were an opening to exploit that...
Armed beasts, the Beastmen... This too is the Shadow Lord's taste. ||| ...How tedious. ||| Let's move on quickly.
I don't know what the Shadow Lord is plotting... ||| but I'm not idle enough to play his games forever. ||| Let's move on quickly.
...Olivier, a word with you later.
Heh, what is it, Mueller? ||| Do you have feelings you want to confide to me?
Fool. I mean checking on your current state. ||| Including what happened just before we were pulled in.
...Olivier, don't get carried away.
I wonder how things are outside, now that we've been pulled in... ||| ...We must find a way out soon.
...From what I hear, it seems we were all pulled in at the same time. ||| I was worried, thinking I'd been pulled in first and this fool was running wild in the outside world...
...I can sort of understand that.
...How rude. ||| At most I'd enjoy a sweet banquet for one night.
It seems we were all pulled in at the same time. ||| ...I feel sorry for those dragged along, but personally it's a blessing in disguise.
...Ah, Julia. ||| You were so helpful on our return trip. ||| How about letting me buy you a drink later?
U-um...
...Captain, you shouldn't take him seriously.
Heh, actually I wanted to get closer to you, Julia, with this chance. ||| I was secretly looking for an opening... no, an opportunity...
I'd advise against it.
*sigh* ...Just give it up.
Ah, haha... ||| I think you'd better give it up...
...I told you not to cause trouble. ||| Stay put quietly.
Unluckily, Mueller found me.
Hehe, Julia. Do let me buy you a drink later.
Hmm, she leaves no openings. ||| Where should I start...
Oh, honestly, Mueller...
Ah, Father Kevin... ||| Heh, it seems you have your share of burdens. ||| I won't ask you to tell all, but since we're caught up in this too, I'll ask for the story later, all right?
Yes, I'll definitely tell you. ||| Sorry, but please wait a little longer.
Heh... Given your profession, you can't tell everything, I suppose... ||| But since we're caught up too, I'll ask for the story later, all right?
Heh, we've had one gorgeous party after another lately. ||| Spending a quiet moment in a place like this once in a while isn't bad.
...You should work a little too.
Everyone, feel free to work Mueller hard. ||| He'll work vigorously in my place.
...No, I doubt the Chancellor is involved in this matter. ||| If that man moved, he wouldn't use such a roundabout method. ||| As for the Serpent, I can't say.
True, it's not like him. ||| And if he wanted to strike, he'd had plenty of chances in the Imperial capital...
Hello, everyone. How's the exploration going? ||| If you find anything, let me know right away.
Prince Olivert, have you been well since then? ||| I hear you've been active in Imperial society...
Heh, for now I'm keeping up the act. ||| But being only an elegant, glamorous noble gives me stiff shoulders. ||| Someday, when the time is right, I plan to show my true self to the world...
--Yes! ||| My true form as the Apostle of Love, the Love Gospeler!
Fool...
Love Gospeler? Seriously...
That sounds even more dangerous than the Gospel...
Hehe... I'm relieved you haven't changed.
...But that ghost of a woman is rather nice. ||| A beautiful phantom left behind alone in the Shadow Realm... ||| Hehe, she gives me quite the thrill.
But that ghost of a woman is rather nice. ||| Perhaps this fantastical garden is to her taste too. ||| Heh, not bad, don't you think?
Joshua... ||| ...It seems you were able to say goodbye.
...Yeah, thanks to you. ||| Still... aren't you a bit too sharp, Kloe?
Haha... ||| You looked a bit more at peace, Joshua.
Oh, um... ||| I got so absorbed reading the books on the shelves... ||| Hehe, I'm resting a little.
Oh, haha... I'm sorry, Josette. ||| I tend to get a little too absorbed...
Still, this is a truly calming place. ||| I was quite surprised the first time I came...
Oh, um, Renne...? ||| Haha, well... ||| Please be careful when you go out exploring.
...Kloe? ||| What are you doing here?
Oh, um... ||| I was a little worried about Renne.
You two have been searching for Renne since leaving Liberl, haven't you?
Yes, we couldn't talk properly at the Axis Pillar.
And there's something I really want to tell Renne...
Hehe, but she looks a bit better. ||| ...Yeah, for now I'd like to keep watching over her like this.
...You're right. ||| There's no point in rushing. ||| In the end, it's Renne's decision... ||| I just hope being pulled into this world, and meeting everyone here, has a good effect on her.
...Yes, you're right.
...Joshua and Kloe? ||| What are you doing here?
Oh, Estelle. ||| It's a little about Renne.
You two have been searching for Renne since leaving Liberl, haven't you?
Yeah, we couldn't talk properly at the Axis Pillar... ||| and there was still something I wanted to tell Renne...
A world that reflects people's feelings... ||| Then perhaps our being gathered here is also someone's will. ||| If so... the Shadow Lord, or the ghost of that woman... ||| or perhaps ourselves.
Facing Renne head-on must be very hard, but... ||| Hehe, I'm sure you and Joshua will be fine. ||| Two people with such a strong bond, surely...
Haha... ||| Thanks, Kloe.
Solve one mystery and a new one blocks the way. ||| ...I see. It really is a well-made game.
I want to help Renne as much as I can. ||| If there's anything I can do, please don't hesitate to ask.
I haven't had a chance to meet Mr. Richard since he left the army, but... ||| I do hear the name of his company from time to time.
Oh, is that so... ||| Maybe it's doing surprisingly well...?
I've heard the name of Mr. Richard's company a few times. ||| R&A Research... I think I remember a small ad in a magazine.
There must still be people who remain sealed. ||| Somewhere in the transformed Le Locle training grounds, or perhaps the next Fifth Stratum... ||| ...Let's move forward.
I'm worried about the people who are sealed. Let's move forward. ||| ...I'm a little worried about Ries too.
(Ugh... I feel like she's seen right through me...)
(As expected of Kloe, so sharp...)
Oh, Zin said he was hungry... ||| Hehe, it's fine. It'll only take a moment.
Still, I'm glad water and food were so easy to get. ||| Perhaps that too is thanks to the ghost... the Garden's Master.
I never imagined Anelace would be pulled in too... ||| ......... ||| ...Joshua, let's press on with the exploration as soon as possible. ||| I'll help as much as I can.
...Joshua, let's press on with the exploration as soon as possible. ||| I'll help as much as I can.
This garden seems to be connected to that woman's ghost. ||| Come to think of it, unlike other dimensions, I feel like something is protecting it.
